title: Sard's theorem and stratified spaces
summary: Sets of measure zero in manifolds; the measure-zero criterion; Sard's theorem that the critical values of a smooth map form a set of measure zero, with proof; consequences (regular values are dense); stratifications of spaces by manifolds.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is lectures 10–12 of the 18.965 notes (Theorems 12.1 and 12.3; Definition 13.1) with Hitchin §10.5 for the special case of Sard's theorem.

preparation.description: Read lectures 10–11: §12 Sard's theorem, Theorem 12.1 (measure-zero criterion) and Theorem 12.3 (Sard) with proof.
Read lecture 12: Definition 13.1 and the examples of stratified spaces.
Read Hitchin appendix §10.5 (Sard's theorem, special case) for the short proof in the equidimensional case.
